common.footer: You're receiving this email because you have a CODpromo account.
common.footerAuth: If you didn't ask for this email, you can safely ignore it. Nothing will change on your account.
common.linkFallback: If the button doesn't work, copy this link into your browser:
common.linkNote: This link works for a limited time and can be used only once.

confirmation.subject: Confirm your email to activate your CODpromo account
confirmation.preheader: One step to go: confirm your email and open your account.
confirmation.title: Confirm your email
confirmation.body: Thanks for signing up to CODpromo. Tap the button to confirm your email and activate your account, then start copying discount codes for your business.

recovery.subject: Reset your CODpromo password
recovery.preheader: Asked for a new password? The link is inside.
recovery.title: Reset your password
recovery.body: We received a request to reset the password for {{email}}. Tap the button to choose a new password.

email_change.subject: Confirm your new CODpromo email
email_change.preheader: One last step to change your account email.
email_change.title: Confirm your email change
email_change.body: You asked to change your account email from {{email}} to {{newEmail}}. Tap the button to confirm the change.
email_change.note: If you didn't ask for this change, ignore this email and change your password to be safe.

magic_link.subject: Your CODpromo sign-in link
magic_link.preheader: Sign in to your account in one tap.
magic_link.title: Your sign-in link
magic_link.body: Tap the button to sign in to your CODpromo account without a password.

invite.subject: You're invited to CODpromo
invite.preheader: Create your account and get started.
invite.title: You have an invitation to CODpromo
invite.body: You've been invited to create a CODpromo account, the discount code platform for cash-on-delivery sellers. Tap the button to accept.

reauthentication.subject: Your CODpromo verification code
reauthentication.preheader: Use this code to confirm the action.
reauthentication.title: Verification code
reauthentication.body: Use the following code to confirm the action on your account:
reauthentication.note: Never share this code. No one at CODpromo will ever ask you for it.

welcome.subject: Your CODpromo account is ready
welcome.preheader: Your email is confirmed. Here's what you can do from your account.
welcome.title: Your account is ready
welcome.body: You've confirmed your email, and your CODpromo account is ready. From your account you copy the codes your business needs at the delivery companies, platforms and tools it relies on, and save the companies you care about.
welcome.keyBody: Every account has one golden key: pick the company you care about, reveal its Premium code, and it stays revealed for you.
welcome.now1: Copy any regular code and use it at the company.
welcome.now2: Save the companies you care about to your favorites.
welcome.now3: Vote on a code after you try it, so others know it works.
welcome.companyBody: You've confirmed your email, and your company's CODpromo account is ready. Add your offers from your dashboard, and we'll review them before publishing them to cash-on-delivery sellers.
welcome.companySubject: Your company's CODpromo account is ready
welcome.companyPreheader: Your email is confirmed, and your company dashboard is ready.

purchase.subject: Your purchase is confirmed: Premium for life
purchase.preheader: Premium is active on your account. Your purchase summary is inside.
purchase.title: Premium is active on your account
purchase.body: Thank you. You paid once, and every Premium code on CODpromo is open to you now, plus everything added later.
purchase.howTitle: How to reveal your first code
purchase.step1: Open the offers in Premium mode.
purchase.step2: Scratch the gold code on the card.
purchase.step3: Copy it and use it at the company.
purchase.refundBody: You can ask for a full refund within 7 days of buying (until {{date}}), as long as you haven't revealed any Premium code since. Send your request from this email address to {{email}}.

revoked.subject: Refund processed and Premium removed from your account
revoked.preheader: We refunded you, and your account is back to regular.
revoked.title: Refund processed
revoked.body: We processed your refund, and lifetime Premium has been removed from your account. Your account stays open, and every regular code is still free for you.
revoked.note: The money can take a few days to appear, depending on your payment method. You can come back to Premium any time.

gift.subject: Your gift has arrived: Premium until {{date}}
gift.preheader: Every Premium code is open to you now.
gift.title: Gift Premium on your account
gift.body: You activated a Premium gift on your account, and every Premium code is now open to you.
gift.note: When the gift ends, your account goes back to regular automatically, with no charge. You can make Premium permanent with one payment from the Premium page.
